_body:
## Section 9.8(a) — Quality Certification Reimbursement

Expenditure incurred for obtaining quality certifications relating to products, processes, or social standards shall be eligible for reimbursement, provided such certifications are recognized by the Quality Council of India or internationally recognized accreditation bodies.
